# 申请卡

## OpenAPI Specification

```yaml
openapi: 3.0.1
info:
  title: ''
  description: ''
  version: 1.0.0
paths:
  /v2/createCard:
    post:
      summary: 申请卡
      deprecated: false
      description: '> V2 无需加密，请求直接提交本页所示的明文 JSON，返回的 `data` 即为本页所示的明文对象。'
      tags:
        - VM卡操作 V2（所有账户可用，推荐）
      parameters:
        - name: Authorization
          in: header
          description: ''
          example: '{{Authorization}}'
          schema:
            type: string
            default: '{{Authorization}}'
      requestBody:
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              properties:
                product_code:
                  type: string
                  description: 产品编码
                first_name:
                  type: string
                  description: 持卡人名
                last_name:
                  type: string
                  description: 持卡人姓
                amount:
                  type: number
                  description: >-
                    储值卡（save）表示首次充值金额，范围 1–50000；当 product_code 对应 share
                    时，对应总额度设置
                single_limit:
                  type: number
                  description: 额度卡单笔限额，为空默认该product_code的最大值
                day_limit:
                  type: number
                  description: 额度卡每日限额，为空默认该product_code的最大值
                month_limit:
                  type: number
                  description: 额度卡每月限额，为空默认该product_code的最大值
                label:
                  type: string
                  description: 卡标签
                card_address:
                  type: object
                  properties:
                    address_line_two:
                      type: string
                      description: 地址2
                    address_line_one:
                      type: string
                      description: 地址1（当填写card_address后字段必传）
                    city:
                      type: string
                      description: 城市（当填写card_address后字段必传）
                    state:
                      type: string
                      description: 州（当填写card_address后字段必传）
                    country:
                      type: string
                      description: 国家（当填写card_address后字段必传）
                    post_code:
                      type: string
                      description: 邮编（当填写card_address后字段必传）
                  x-apifox-orders:
                    - address_line_one
                    - address_line_two
                    - city
                    - state
                    - country
                    - post_code
                  required:
                    - address_line_one
                    - city
                    - state
                    - country
                    - post_code
                  description: >-
                    地址信息。可不传；传了以后，除 address_line_two
                    外其余字段都必填；地址只支持字母、数字、空格和连字符（-），不支持中文和 , . # @ 等符号
                area_code:
                  type: string
                  description: 区号
                mobile:
                  type: string
                  description: 手机号
                email:
                  type: string
                  description: 邮箱
              required:
                - product_code
                - first_name
                - last_name
                - amount
              x-apifox-orders:
                - product_code
                - first_name
                - last_name
                - amount
                - single_limit
                - day_limit
                - month_limit
                - label
                - card_address
                - area_code
                - mobile
                - email
            example:
              product_code: Q5334PH
              first_name: San
              last_name: Zhang
              amount: 100
              label: ads-01
      responses:
        '200':
          description: ''
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  code:
                    type: integer
                  data:
                    type: object
                    properties:
                      card_id:
                        type: string
                        description: 卡ID
                      vm_card_id:
                        type: string
                        description: VM 卡 ID
                    required:
                      - card_id
                      - vm_card_id
                    x-apifox-orders:
                      - card_id
                      - vm_card_id
                  msg:
                    type: string
                required:
                  - code
                  - msg
                  - data
                x-apifox-orders:
                  - code
                  - msg
                  - data
          headers: {}
          x-apifox-name: 成功
      security: []
      x-apifox-folder: VM卡操作 V2（所有账户可用，推荐）
      x-apifox-status: released
      x-run-in-apifox: https://app.apifox.com/web/project/6388598/apis/api-531009974-run
components:
  schemas: {}
  securitySchemes: {}
servers:
  - url: https://sandbox-api.vmcardio.com
    description: API开发者
security: []

```
